description:
When ClickHouse support was split into `clickhouse-local` and
`clickhouse-server` platforms (`first-class-clickhouse-local-server-cloud-platforms`,
DONE 2026-04-11), a set of temporary compatibility aliases were added so
that existing `platform: clickhouse` references continue to work during a
deprecation window.

The DONE file defers two cleanup tasks:
(a) Remove the temporary `clickhouse` compatibility aliases entirely after
    one deprecation window.
(b) Backfill or rewrite historical result artifacts so old `clickhouse`
    platform labels are normalized to `clickhouse-local` or `clickhouse-server`.

This TODO tracks (a). Artifact backfill (b) is a separate larger operation
that depends on a decision about whether old result artifacts should be
mutated; it should be filed separately if needed.

anti_patterns.dont: backfill historical result artifacts in this TODO
anti_patterns.why: scope it to alias removal only

anti_patterns.dont: remove the alias without the helpful error message
anti_patterns.why: silent 'platform not found' errors are harder to diagnose

deferrals.reason: Mutating stored result artifacts requires a separate decision about historical record integrity; file separately if needed.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Historical-artifact backfill explicitly deferred pending a separate decision on mutating stored records; no such decision made.
deferrals.summary: Backfill historical result artifacts: rename old clickhouse labels to clickhouse-local or clickhouse-server

preserves.behavior: Error message for the removed 'clickhouse' alias names the replacements explicitly
clickhouse-local and clickhouse-server platforms continue to work correctly after alias removal

work_units.notes:
Remove the platform alias mapping entries from benchbox/platforms/ (likely
a PLATFORM_ALIASES or similar dict). After removal, benchbox run --platform
clickhouse should fail with a clear error message naming the replacements
(clickhouse-local, clickhouse-server).

When platform='clickhouse' is passed after alias removal, raise a clear
error:
  "Platform 'clickhouse' has been removed. Use 'clickhouse-local' or
  'clickhouse-server' instead."
This prevents silent breakage for callers who missed the deprecation notice.
work_units.summary: Add a helpful error message for the removed alias
